system.description:
Range: 30 spaces

Cost: 2 Resolve

You sing the song of the Dead Mother, and its haunting beauty beguiles your foes.

Until the start of your next turn, any creature within 30 spaces of you must make a Willpower check opposed by your Soul (Metaphysics). If it fails, it must use all available Actions and Moves to be as near to you as possible. After moving as close as it can, it stops and listens to your song.

You may designate a number of creatures equal to your Training in Metaphysics to exclude from this effect.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect. This effect automatically ends for a creature if it is harmed or becomes otherwise unable to hear you, or if you speak for any purpose other than to continue the song.
